info.title: Do You Like Big Girls?
info.synopsis: Sōta Tachibana è un freeter poliedrico che passa da un lavoro part-time all’altro, distinguendosi soprattutto per la sua bassa statura. La sua vita cambia quando la sorella maggiore Kaoru, alta quasi due metri, lo coinvolge come assistente nella squadra di pallavolo femminile dell’università di cui fa parte. Sōta si ritrova così a lavorare a stretto contatto con un gruppo di ragazze tutte molto alte, atletiche e dalla forte personalità, finendo per essere immerso in un ambiente completamente nuovo per lui. La sua presenza, così diversa da quella delle giocatrici, attira rapidamente la loro attenzione, dando vita a dinamiche vivaci e spesso imbarazzanti.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Tall Kaori and short Sota are siblings by marriage. One day, commanded by Kaori, Sota becomes the dorm manager and coach for her university women's volleyball team. Among the members is Ayano, his first love, and they have an unexpected reunion! Sota begins living together with the club members as the dorm manager. But that night, he witnesses an unexpected side of Ayano, whom he's always admired...?!

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Kaori, who had suggested the date herself, becomes flustered upon learning that Sota and Ayano went to a hotel. Still, as Sota's sister, she tries to mediate between them... Meanwhile, Sakura, Kyoka, and Yuria, having heard the whole story, come up with a bizarre theory: Since they're also members of the girls' volleyball club like Ayano, they should have the right to do the same thing! And so, they begin seducing Sota!

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Everyone is present at the girls' dormitory, now with the club president, Sanae, who had been absent for a while due to family circumstances, returning to the volleyball club. Sanae, a libero specializing in defense, is petite despite being on the volleyball team, and Sota finds himself drawn to her, who is shorter than him. The group decides to hold a Genghis Khan party to celebrate Sanae's return and Sota's appointment as coach. But that night, an unexpected hint of romance awaited Sota!

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Sakura is always full of jokes. One day, when Sota tells her that she'd be cute if she just acted normal, a certain memory resurfaces. Back in elementary school, Sakura, already tall for her age, played the clown while spending her days with her male friend, Takeshi. Eventually, they entered middle school and both joined the volleyball club. However, a rift gradually formed between Sakura, blessed with physique and talent, and Takeshi, who was not...

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: One night, Kaori, wearing only her underwear, comes to Sota's room seeking help. Sota is shocked, but it turns out the club members were holding a strip mahjong tournament. With Kaori facing certain defeat, she makes a last-ditch effort to recruit Sota as her substitute player. The tournament's grand prize was... the right to do whatever they wanted with Sota?! Reluctant but needing to protect himself, Sota joins the game. Meanwhile, Kaori seems to have her own thoughts on the matter...

episodes.title: Episodio 6

Mental care is also an important job for the dorm manager and coach... Sota hurriedly chases after her!

episodes.title: Episodio 7

And so, the match between the volleyball team and basketball team begins!

episodes.synopsis: Today is Valentine's Day! Kaoru and Kyoka, with their tall figure and short hair, are treated like princesses and receive chocolates from their female fans. It contains something not found in ordinary family chocolates...

episodes.synopsis: Kaoru couldn't shake the words Ayano had said to her on Valentine's Day night regarding her feelings for Sota. They go clothes shopping together, eat dinner, and drink out. But then, drunk, Kaoru declares she doesn't want to go home...!

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: The unexpected date with Sota begins. Fueled by alcohol, Kaoru ends up going into a hotel with him, reminiscing about their childhood. Tall and nicknamed the "Witch of Toyohira," Kaoru often protected the smaller, bullied Sota. Kaoru advised him that if he really fought back, things will work out—but that advice relied on Kaoru's own physique. What is the surprising suggestion Kaoru makes to Sota who has half-given up...?

info.title: Do You Like Big Girls?
info.originalTitle: Ookii Onnanoko wa Suki desu ka?
info.synopsis: Sōta Tachibana è un freeter poliedrico che passa da un lavoro part-time all’altro, distinguendosi soprattutto per la sua bassa statura. La sua vita cambia quando la sorella maggiore Kaoru, alta quasi due metri, lo coinvolge come assistente nella squadra di pallavolo femminile dell’università di cui fa parte. Sōta si ritrova così a lavorare a stretto contatto con un gruppo di ragazze tutte molto alte, atletiche e dalla forte personalità, finendo per essere immerso in un ambiente completamente nuovo per lui. La sua presenza, così diversa da quella delle giocatrici, attira rapidamente la loro attenzione, dando vita a dinamiche vivaci e spesso imbarazzanti.
